summary.text: Aisha Gomez is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 62A, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2019, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists no other candidate in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Aisha Gomez lives in Minneapolis, Minnesota, and earned a B.S. in environmental science from the University of Minnesota in 2010.

Her career experience includes working as a community organizer and development coordinator for the Women's Environmental Institute and as a senior policy aide to Councilmember Alondra Cano in the City of Minneapolis.
Aisha Gomez defeated Alexandra Hoffman Novick in the November 5, 2024 general election.
Gomez's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the House Taxes Committee (as Co-Chair) and the Ways and Means Committee.
